source.citation: YouGov, February 24-27, 2023, 31,380 U.S. adults: 68% have decided to end a friendship and followed through (https://yougov.com/en-us/articles/45676-americans-ended-friendship-breakups-poll). The base rate is solved so that share of adults has at least one falling-out among the people they shared a class or workgroup with.
source.estimatedFrom: A pair's chance of falling out builds over the years they shared, rising with both people's conflict and falling with both people's reliability; each pair carries its own line, keyed to the pair, and falls out on the date its built-up chance reaches it. A generated town is a sample of its place, so a group with fewer generated members than a full group has each pair stand for the missing peers: the rate is scaled by the full group's peers over the generated ones.
